scope: Independent static review and focused actual-installer regression; root owns real hosted browser checks.
dialogAssessment: A/B inspector remains a max-height flex dialog with min-height:0 overflow:auto contained body. Encounter source dialog and fixed preview drawer retain bounded scrolling. No changed dialog height or overflow clipping declarations.
navigationAssessment: Observer synchronization only adjusts the inner rail. Outer page scroll exists solely in explicit revealTopicStart path. Toolbar class and offset styles are absent from the observed attribute filter; offset write is value-guarded; sticky-to-static does not change normal-flow toolbar dimensions. Resize callbacks coalesce in requestAnimationFrame.

stable measurements avoid repeated style writes
